title: Resumption of Online Sick/Leave Note Filing Functionality
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: 21-06-2021 Registrar (SCMS & ICT)

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
CIRCULAR
Subject: Resumption of Online Sick/Leave Note Filing Functionality
With regard to the subject given above, this is to inform all concerned
that, as per the directions of Honourable the Chief Justice, the requisite
technical preparations for resuming the online functionality for facilitating filing
of sick note / leave note by the Ld. Advocates have been completed.
Accordingly, the Online Sick/Leave Note Filing Functionality has been
resumed from today i.e. the 21st June, 2021 as available from Case Status
website of the High Court at http://gujarathc-casestatus.nic.in/gujarathc/ under
the SICK-LEAVE NOTE tile.
Although the functioning of the Online Sick/Leave Note filing will remain
the same as before, as the causelist is published two days in advance; the
updation of leave note applied for next working day would reflect only after the
causelist is re-published in the evening of of the previous working day.
As further directed, in the present situation and to avoid any delays in
updation of sick/leave notes in the system, only the online mode of sick/leave
note filing is being resumed.
Sd/-
Date: 21-06-2021 Registrar (SCMS & ICT)
